exposure: transfer of blastocysts derived from 2PN embryos
transfer of blastocysts derived from 0PN and 1PN embryos
cohort: 7,284 women who underwent single blastocyst transfers between 2012 and 2020, including 386 from 0PN, 316 from 1PN, and 6582 from 2PN embryos
finding: Transferring blastocysts derived from 0PN and 1PN zygotes did not negatively impact reproductive outcomes or increase maternal and perinatal complications compared to transferring blastocysts derived from 2PN zygotes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was comparable between the groups.
